command:
set -euo pipefail; snapshot_count(){ D="$1"; for N in $(seq 1 12); do rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database > "$D/tracker_database"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-wal > "$D/tracker_database-wal" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$D/tracker_database-wal"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-shm > "$D/tracker_database-shm" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$D/tracker_database-shm"; OUT=$(sqlite3 "$D/tracker_database" 'PRAGMA integrity_check; SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signal_samples;' 2>/dev/null || true); OK=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | head -n1); COUNT=$(printf '%s
' "$OUT" | tail -n1); if [ "$OK" = ok ] && printf '%s' "$COUNT" | grep -Eq '^[0-9]+$'; then echo "$COUNT"; return 0; fi; sleep 0.25; done; echo COHERENT_SNAPSHOT_FAILED >&2; return 1; }; C1=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-v4-on1); sleep 8; C2=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-v4-on2); echo SCREEN_ON_COUNTS=$C1,$C2; test "$C2" -gt "$C1" || { echo INCONCLUSIVE_NO_SCREEN_ON_RF_GROWTH >&2; exit 31; }; adb logcat -c; BEFORE=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-v4-off-before); PID_BEFORE=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); echo SCREEN_OFF_BEFORE=$BEFORE; adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP; sleep 5; P1=$(adb shell dumpsys power | grep -E 'mWakefulness=|Display Power: state=' | head -n 10 || true); echo "$P1"; echo "$P1" | grep -Eq 'mWakefulness=(Asleep|Dozing)|Display Power: state=OFF' || { echo INCONCLUSIVE_PHONE_NOT_ASLEEP >&2; exit 40; }; sleep 35; P2=$(adb shell dumpsys power | grep -E 'mWakefulness=|Display Power: state=' | head -n 10 || true); echo "$P2"; echo "$P2" | grep -Eq 'mWakefulness=(Asleep|Dozing)|Display Power: state=OFF' || { echo INCONCLUSIVE_PHONE_WOKE_DURING_TEST >&2; exit 41; }; PID_OFF=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test "$PID_OFF" = "$PID_BEFORE" || exit 42; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'isForeground=true'; AFTER=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-v4-off-after); echo SCREEN_OFF_COUNTS=$BEFORE,$AFTER; test "$AFTER" -gt "$BEFORE" || { echo SCREEN_OFF_SAMPLE_GROWTH_FAIL >&2; exit 43; }; adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP; sleep 3; adb shell wm dismiss-keyguard >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; PID_WAKE=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test "$PID_WAKE" = "$PID_BEFORE"; LOGS=$(adb logcat -d -v brief); echo '--- BLE_MODE_LOGS ---'; echo "$LOGS" | grep -E 'Switching passive BLE scan|Passive BLE scan mode switched' | tail -n 30 || true; echo "$LOGS" | grep -q 'Switching passive BLE scan from BROAD to BACKGROUND_FILTERED'; echo "$LOGS" | grep -q 'Switching passive BLE scan from BACKGROUND_FILTERED to BROAD'; echo "$LOGS" | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|OutOfMemoryError|SQLiteException|SecurityException' && exit 44 || true; echo PHASE3_FIXED_SCREENOFF_ACCEPTANCE_PASS
